title: Canonical coefficient section maps and evaluated units
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and write $\Lambda_Z=p_Z^*\Lambda$ for its coefficient sheaf [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on each small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the canonical coefficient mate $\eta_f:\Lambda_Y\to f_*\Lambda_X$ for a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. Define $1_{Z,T}\in\Lambda_Z(T)$ by evaluating the internal ring unit at $T\to Z$ and at $1\in\mathbf Z$. For $T\to B$ a pro-etale object, define $\theta_T:\Lambda_B(T)\to\Gamma(T,\Lambda_T)$ by evaluating $\eta_{T\to B}$ at $T$ and then restricting along the diagonal $T\to T\times_BT$. For any $f:X\to Y$, define $f^\sharp:\Gamma(Y,\Lambda_Y)\to\Gamma(X,\Lambda_X)$ by evaluating $\eta_f$ at the final object $Y/Y$ and restricting along the canonical graph from $X/X$ to its pullback. These are specified additive maps and an evaluated unit, with no inverse chosen and no bijectivity asserted.
